title: Week 2: Multi-Step Equations and Literal Formulas
prerequisites: Week 1 equivalents, equality-preserving transformations, solving one-variable equations
Sign arithmetic and distribution with positive/negative coefficients

dailyPlan.topic: Equations with fractions and rational coefficients
dailyPlan.target: Solve multi-step linear equations with fractions and explain each equivalent step.
dailyPlan.workedModel: (3/4)x+5=11 gives (3/4)x=6 and x=8; verify by substitution.
dailyPlan.guidedEvidence: Complete three examples with different denominator signs and explain equivalence.
dailyPlan.independentEvidence: Solve and check five rational-coefficient equations.
dailyPlan.exitTicket: Solve (x-4)/3=5; explain a legal first transformation.

dailyPlan.topic: Solving literal equations for a specified variable
dailyPlan.target: Isolate one symbol in formulas with multiple letters and state any nonzero restrictions.
dailyPlan.diagnostic: Distinguish a solution for x from a formula describing x using other variables.
dailyPlan.workedModel: d=rt, where r≠0, yields t=d/r; P=2l+2w yields w=(P-2l)/2.
dailyPlan.guidedEvidence: Rearrange A=lw and y=mx+b with named target variables.
dailyPlan.independentEvidence: Derive, interpret, and check three formulas in context.
dailyPlan.exitTicket: Solve C=2πr for r and name the unit of r.

dailyPlan.topic: Equations with variables on both sides and denominator clearing
dailyPlan.target: Choose efficient legal transformations and detect restrictive or extraneous steps.
dailyPlan.diagnostic: Critique a solution where only one side of an equation is multiplied.
dailyPlan.guidedEvidence: Solve three equations and verify each answer in the original equation.
dailyPlan.independentEvidence: Contrast clearing fractions versus using rational operations; explain which is more efficient.

dailyPlan.topic: Multi-step modeling with physical quantities and units
dailyPlan.target: Build an equation from a real context, define a variable, and interpret the solution domain.
dailyPlan.diagnostic: Given a phone-plan fee and per-use cost, decide which quantities are fixed.
dailyPlan.workedModel: Fixed $18 plus $7 per visit totals $74: 18+7v=74, v=8 visits.
dailyPlan.guidedEvidence: Model two tuition or service pricing contexts and label units and constraints.
dailyPlan.independentEvidence: Solve and critique a constructed budget or distance problem with justified whole-number restrictions.
dailyPlan.exitTicket: State a feasible contextual solution and check it against the original statement.

dailyPlan.topic: Transfer, formative checkpoint, and targeted reteaching
dailyPlan.target: Demonstrate solutions to equations and literal formulas independently with explanations and checks.
dailyPlan.diagnostic: Revisit recurring errors from the first four exit tickets.
dailyPlan.workedModel: Compare distinct solution strategies for a rational linear equation.
dailyPlan.guidedEvidence: Peer critique of a deliberately flawed multi-step equation derivation.
dailyPlan.independentEvidence: Teacher-scored problem set covering fractional equations, literal formulas, and contextual modeling.
dailyPlan.exitTicket: Written reflection: identify one error corrected and name evidence of improved reasoning.

assessmentPlan.notes: Four multi-step equation and literal formula tasks; teacher feedback before checkpoint.
Ten points fractional equation solving, ten points formula rearrangement, ten points applied modeling with units and checking.

teacherReviewChecklist: Verify every worked derivation and numerical answer
Confirm standard identifiers with a qualified mathematics educator
Review accessibility and accommodations for fraction notation
Provide protected scoring key and common misconceptions separately from student lessons
